headline: Chile Telecom Operator Entel Announces 2029 Financial Targets
summary: Entel presented its 2029 growth targets for mobile, home internet, and enterprise services during Investor Day, prioritizing Chilean market expansion.
why: Empresa Nacional de Telecomunicaciones (Entel) is a principal telecommunications service provider in Chile.

impacts.name: Entel
impacts.why: Entel set financial and operational performance goals for 2029.
